scheme_name: Subsidy for Asset Creation for Intellectual Property: Subsidy on the Cost of Trade Mark Registration or Geographical Indications (GI) in India or Abroad
other_conditions: All new and existing micro, small and medium manufacturing enterprises including clusters are eligible
Enterprises must be located anywhere in Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on trademark or GI registration costs up to ₹25,000 per mark, with reimbursement up to ₹1,00,000.
